summary: MSD Investment Corp. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce the pricing of a $300 million private placement of 6.375% notes due 2029. The offering, made to QIBs under Rule 144A and non-U.S. persons under Regulation S, is expected to close on June 12, 2026. Proceeds will repay revolving credit facility debt or be used for general corporate purposes, including portfolio investments. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. The notes are unregistered and not redeemable prior to May 12, 2029 except at make-whole. No special-situation risk or arbitrage angle exists.
